import hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess
m=json.loads(pathlib.Path('/tmp/kk-cleanup-review.NBNhfk/manifest.json').read_text())
changed=[]
for item in m['evidence']:
    if item['role']=='candidate':
        data=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',':'+item['original_path']])
        if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()!=item['sha256']:
            changed.append(item['original_path'])
print(json.dumps({'candidate_changed_since_snapshot':changed}))
